consumer.role: Local downstream technical reviewer preparing later builder admission
consumer.boundary: Judge source fidelity, requirement coverage, and validation discrimination before any builder admission

requirementCoverage.title: Compile one weekly report
statements: System compiles all entries into one weekly report

requirementCoverage.title: Mark missing, late and duplicate entries
statements: Late, missing and duplicate entries are marked in the report

requirementCoverage.title: Export compiled report and team sections by role
statements: Team leads view and edit only their own entries and may export their own team's section. The department head views and exports all. Auditors have read-only view and no export.
Department head exports the compiled report

requirementCoverage.title: Corrections until the Friday deadline
statements: Team leads may correct their entry until the Friday 17:00 deadline
Submitted entries are immutable once submitted
resolutions: corrections before Friday 17:00 create a new entry version; after the deadline entries are immutable

requirementCoverage.title: No automatic scoring of people
statements: No automatic scoring or ranking of team leads or people.

designProposals.text: Entry record: equipment line code, status text, submitting team lead, submission time.
Role-scoped export interface: department head full export, team lead team-section export, auditors read-only.
Versioned submission workflow: pre-deadline edits create new versions, post-deadline submissions locked or immutable.

taskPlan.title: Mark missing, late and duplicate entries
Export for department head and team leads
Retain compiled reports for twelve months

validationSpecifications.text: A fixture CSV with N entries yields one report with the same N entries.
A fixture with one missing, one late and one duplicate entry shows three visible marks.
Department head role can export compiled report; team lead role can export own team section; unauthorized roles cannot export.
A correction before the deadline creates a new entry version; entries after deadline are immutable.
No score or ranking field exists in the report or compiled output.

Compiled report survives and is retrievable at 11.5 months and at the exact 12-month boundary; premature deletion before 12 months (e.g. at 11.5 months) is rejected; retention respects timezone without unrequested purge.

survivalAt11Point5Months.condition: Report must be fully present and retrievable at creationTimestamp + 11.5 months
survivalAt11Point5Months.purpose: Verifies data has not been purged prematurely before requirement horizon

survivalAt12MonthBoundary.condition: Report must be present at creationTimestamp + 12 months (boundary test)
survivalAt12MonthBoundary.purpose: Verifies exact 12-month retention requirement is satisfied

earlyDeletionCounterexampleRejection.condition: Any purge/delete operation requested at or before 11.5 months must be rejected with RETENTION_VIOLATION error
earlyDeletionCounterexampleRejection.purpose: Discriminating check resolving T1H LD-3: ensures the test actively fails if deletion occurs early

timezoneAdherence.condition: Creation and retention boundary timestamps must compute against declared timezone once U2 is resolved
timezoneAdherence.purpose: Prevents retention boundary drift due to UTC offset discrepancies

noUnrequestedPurgeAt12Months.condition: App must not automatically delete data at month 12 unless explicit auto-purge policy is authorized
noUnrequestedPurgeAt12Months.purpose: User requirement states 'reports are kept 12 months', not 'reports must be destroyed on day 366'
